notes:
• Log time is simpler: hours, your note and Save, with one line like "Today · Remote · Billable". Click that line to change the day, work type or billing.
• My time has one Add button for ticket time, internal time, a new ticket or PTO. New ticket from My time books on the day you're looking at.
• New ticket's Book time now lets you pick the day, up to 90 days back.
• Support desk (managers and Marina): click a ticket to read it, again to open it beside the list. Tick several to assign or close them at once.
• Time on this ticket and the set-once settings fold away until you want them.
• The hours in the sidebar always match the day underneath.
